reason: Compact checkpoint platform geometry with decal texture and baseline touch logic suitable for adaptation into the ordered progression system.

serializedMedia.purpose: Visual decal graphic displayed across the top surface of the checkpoint platform.

sources.behavior: Listens to Touched on the parent part, detects player humanoids, stores the current spawn in ServerStorage, and binds CharacterAdded to position Torso at the checkpoint.

requirements.reason: The script handles basic touch-based checkpoint assignment, but lacks sequential order validation (1 -> 2 -> 3) and allows skipping directly to any touched pad.
Pad visual mesh and decal exist, but visual activation tweening, glowing indicator changes, and chime audio playback must be integrated.

permissionImpacts.reason: The source only references in-memory ServerStorage instances and does not invoke DataStore APIs.
No HttpService or external web requests are utilized.
No global _G or shared tables are accessed.

integrationNotes: Refactor checkpoint script logic into a centralized server manager enforcing strictly sequential progression (CP1 -> CP2 -> CP3).
Replace R6 'Torso' dependency with HumanoidRootPart positioning for cross-rig R15/R6 compatibility.
Attach PointLight/SpotLight and Sound instances to trigger visual activation effects and audio cues upon valid checkpoint touch.
